Bea (CS): Heads up: AuroraEdge wants to onboard a customer-finetuned 13B summarizer into Redwood Private. Requirements: PHI-safe processing, HSM-backed KMS, VPC-only control plane, and a pre-renewal hallucination/regression eval. Theyre targeting p95 <= 140ms for ~512-token outputs and expect ~25-35 qps bursts. Can ML/security advise feasibility?

Marco (AM): Ill confirm renewal timing and DPA status. They prefer A10G for cost but will consider A100 if needed. Renewal sentiment: "likely" if perf + safety checks pass.

Diego (ML Eng): 140ms p95 for 512 tokens on 13B is aggressive. Need artifacts: model tar/ONNX, tokenizer, 50-100 sample prompts, and a short latency trace. Suggest initial plan: test on A10G with 8-bit quant + KV caching; if not, escalate to A100 or propose distilled 7B.

Sofia (Security): HSM + VPC private control plane supported. Security asks: dataflow diagram, signed DPA, retention policy, list of external integrations (EHR, SFTP). If they want zero logs, we need an audit exception. Also request clarifying whether de-id happens client-side.

Bea (CS): Action items: 1) Ask AuroraEdge for artifact bundle and privacy docs (due 3bd). 2) Diego to draft perf feasibility and fallback options (3bd). 3) Sofia to draft HSM/onboarding checklist (3bd). 4) OnboardBot to create intake ticket and request Dedicated eval.

OnboardBot: Intake ticket created: CS-2026-5120. Provision ETA: 1781238200.

Diego (ML Eng): For faster profiling, ask them to run this sample curl and paste timing:
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://staging.aurora.example/eval -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"docs":["<doc1>","<doc2>","<doc3>"],"max_tokens":512}' -w '\nTime_total:%{time_total}\n'
```

Bea (CS): Thanks all. Ill post the intake doc link here when I have it and schedule kickoff once artifacts arrive. Marking renewal-risk: monitoring until eval completes.
